title: Nick Cook rebuffed by a scared George Trimble

tellings.quote: But when aviation journalist, Nick Cook, tried to meet with the then long retired 80 something year old George Trimble through a friend of his at Lockheed Martin,
Trimble didn't want to speak to me, and he was really quite spooked at the idea of speaking to me.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Cook rather than by the host, and names Martin Corporation alongside Lockheed.
tellings.link_reason: The same event: the frightened, elderly George Trimble refused to talk to Nick Cook through Lockheed Martin.

as_told.title: George Trimble refuses to be interviewed

plain: When the aviation journalist Nick Cook tried to meet George Trimble, a long-retired aerospace man then in his eighties, through a friend at Lockheed Martin, Trimble refused and seemed frightened. Michels first told the story himself in 2023, and in 2024 Cook told it to him firsthand, also naming the Martin company: "Trimble didn't want to speak to me, and he was really quite spooked at the idea of speaking to me." Cook was looking into secret anti-gravity research, and he takes the old man's fear as a sign that Trimble knew something he would not say.
